resume.title: User Resume
resume.description: Stores user resume information, personal details, work experience, and administrative status

userId.description: The UID of the user or applicant who owns this resume

title.description: Title or applicant name of the resume

status.description: Processing status managed by administrator (e.g. pending, in_progress, completed)

adminNotes.description: Internal consultation notes written by welfare center admin

photoUploadedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the personal photo was uploaded

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the resume was first created

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the resume was last updated

/resumes/{resumeId}.description: Collection of resumes created by applicants and managed by administrators

/admins/{adminId}.description: Collection of authorized welfare center administrators
